title: kate-ui: name the reload and keep answers
summary: disk_answer_line names the two sheet answers. Reload says Reload the file from disk. Keep says Keep the buffer. The file watcher and Command::CheckDisk stay out of this packet. The test goes in the existing notice tests module.
